Take a break and come here; you’ll truly forget all your corporate toxicity. A huge shoutout to Roshan and Rakhidum. Thanks to them, I really enjoyed my time here.

Had a wonderful experience at Thrilled Food with my kids! They absolutely loved the food, and everything was delicious.
